title: From THE NETHER: Expansion Pack (Movie Mod)
description: Adds the Real Life dimension, the potato launcher along with other movie stuff!
body:
This mod adds "The Real Life" dimension And the "Potato Launcher", to access the dimension, you need to build a NETHER Portal frame and light it with a "Fire Bucket".

# Showcase ### - The Real Life Dimension A dimension inspired by the Minecraft Movie. ![Old version of the dimension](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ReTvXABo/images/258a8234f7062e1d5084667f9592dec1d9355ac6.png) ### - Potato Launcher A recreation of the Potato Launcher from the Minecraft Movie. **Recipe:** ![Potato Launcher Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bbbab0b1e48ab753b2afcf45bf613ea17879b55a.png) ### - Fire Bucket An item that lights the portal of the Real Life Dimension. **Recipe:** ![Fire Bucket recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45cbdb5a8cea850425258611d4cad0b21aa116d5.png)
